text:
maya: RFC follow-up: proposing a 'scheduling spine' to separate admission, lane composition, and batch-cut. want to capture tradeoffs before we rework the batcher.
aj: +1. need a clear boundary for latency vs throughput knobs. admission should be policy-only; it should signal but not mutate batch shapes. :thumbsup:
leo: rough Admit API idea: 
```
AdmitResult admit(Request r, TenantState s, Time now)
EvictHint evict(Queue q, Budget b)
```
Keep it tiny so multiple heuristics can plug in.
sasha: KV-cache warmup is orthogonal but affects latency tails. admission should be able to return WarmupHint (prefix hotness) or we face cold-start p95 regressions.
maya: agreed. AdmitResult: {allow|queue|reject, optional WarmupHint, DeadlineHint, optional FallbackHook, optional LeaseTaperHint}. Lease taper = when preempting, gradually reduce tenant lease to avoid retransmit storms.
aj: telemetry needs: per-tenant backlog, batch-shape histograms, headroom-utilization, enqueue/drop counters, token p95. without this we can't tune defaults.
leo: rollout plan: adapter shim that translates old batcher calls to new scheduler API so we can incrementally migrate. keep client enqueue API stable.
sasha: fairness: mixing tiny low-latency requests with large long-context jobs starves small ones. soft credits + aging looks simplest. we should add a quick sim harness (traffic mixes, model sizes, prefix hotness).
maya: plan: build sim, implement Admit API + WarmupHint, adaptor shim, and a lane config DSL that's declarative so ops can tweak. example DSL idea: 
lanes:
  - name: low-latency
    policy: min-latency
    budget_ms: 30
  - name: bulk
    policy: max-throughput
    max_batch_tokens: 512
admission: composable_modules: [rate_limit, headroom, warmup_hint]
aj: CI/ops checklist: staging canary 10% hosts, synthetic tail tests, tenant fairness tests. perf targets: p50 within 5% of baseline, p95 headroom <= baseline +10%.
runtime-bot: ci-batcher-tests: green 13/215 tests.
sasha: emergency escape hatch: if headroom drops below threshold, admission should trigger FallbackHook to route to smaller compatible model variant. that needs policy hooks and operator controls.
maya: will open a short RFC PR encoding API shape, DSL, telemetry plan, and sim scenarios. please comment with scenarios to run. :raised_hands:
